class.name: DiscordAuthResult
class.description: Contains the JWT and user metadata returned by the discord-auth-golang backend, or error details on failure.

method.name: get_client_id
method.description: Discord application client ID echoed by the auth server.

method.name: get_discord_id
method.description: Discord user snowflake ID verified by the auth server.

method.name: get_http_status
method.description: HTTP status code from the auth server response.

method.name: get_jwt
method.description: Signed JWT issued by the auth server on success.

method.name: get_username
method.description: Discord username verified by the auth server.
